about_short_description.short_description: Otida is an app that acts as a nutritionist, a fitness coach and physician, among other roles, for patients with diabetes.

product.name: Otida Program
product.description: A comprehensive care model for type 2 diabetes patients, offering personalized nutrition plans, exercise routines, and continuous monitoring and support by a multidisciplinary team.

product.name: CGM Blood Sugar Readings
product.description: Continuous Glucose Monitor readings are used to track patients' blood glucose levels in real-time, allowing for immediate adjustments to treatment plans.

product.name: Nutrition Plans
product.description: Customized dietary guidelines designed to control blood sugar levels, based on individual health data and lifestyle.

product.name: Exercise Routines
product.description: Personalized exercise plans tailored to fit the patient's lifestyle and improve their blood sugar control.

product.name: Continuous Monitoring and Support
product.description: Ongoing assessment of the patient's health data, including blood sugar levels, diet, and exercise, with the support of a dedicated care team.

product.name: Educational Curriculum
product.description: A comprehensive educational program covering diabetes management, nutrition, and lifestyle changes to support patients' understanding of their condition.
